program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # input pair L
    "itail": (14e-6, 6e-6, 40e-6),   # first-stage tail current
    "Lp":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # PMOS mirror load L (sets A1)
    "I7":    (100e-6, 40e-6, 180e-6),# second-stage current
    "gmid7": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # second-stage PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # second-stage PMOS L
    "Ln":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc":    (2e-12, 0.8e-12, 4e-12),# Miller cap
    "kz":    (2.0, 0.8, 4.0),        # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = spec.get("vdd", 1.8); vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    itail, I7 = p["itail"], p["I7"]
    gmid_b = 9.0

    # ---- bias reference: ibias -> R -> diode nb (nb drives NMOS current sources)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Ln"], iref, vds=mb0.vgs)

    # ---- input pair (iterate on source voltage for body effect)
    vs = 0.3
    for _ in range(6):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], itail / 2, vds=0.2, vsb=vs)
        vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Ln"], itail, vds=max(vs, 0.1))

    # ---- NMOS cascodes: gate tied to ibias pin (vb = vgs_b + iref*R)
    vd1 = vs + max(0.2, m1.vdsat + 0.1)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], itail / 2, vds=vd1 - vs, vsb=vs)
    # second stage first, to know the first-stage output DC level
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=0.9)
    vout1 = vdd - m7.vgs
    mc = lut.size("n", 15.0, 0.5, itail / 2, vds=max(vout1 - vd1, 0.15), vsb=vd1)
    vb = vd1 + mc.vgs
    rb = max((vb - mb0.vgs) / iref, 1e3)

    # ---- PMOS mirror load (long L for gain)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 8.0, p["Lp"], itail / 2, vds=1.1)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 8.0, p["Lp"], itail / 2, vds=m3.vgs)

    # ---- second-stage NMOS current source
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Ln"], I7, vds=vdd - vcm)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.R("RB", "ibias", "nb", rb)
    n.dev("MB0", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diode side driven by vinn, output side by vinp (overall non-inverting from vinp)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MC1", "d1", "ibias", "x1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("MC2", "o1", "ibias", "x2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "nb", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions
    rout1 = 1.0 / (m3.gds + m1.gds * mc.gds / (mc.gm + mc.gmbs))
    A1 = m1.gm * rout1
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + mc.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm / (2 * PI * (cl + C1 + cl * C1 / Cc))
    zden = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * zden) if zden > 0 else 1e12
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    fm = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m3.cdd))
    pm = (90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / z))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fm)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (2 * fm))))
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + I7)
    swing = (vdd - m7.vdsat - 0.05) - (m8.vdsat + 0.05)
    slew = min(itail / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))

    return n, {"gain_db": db(A1 * A2), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew}
